_doc: THE canonical per-class prompts + params for the unified room pipeline (qa/paint_room.py). Added 2026-07-15 after the image-vs-controlImage slot postmortem (qa/evidence/gemini-restyle/FLUX_ROOTCAUSE.md): a compacted agent reconstructed API calls from memory and silently swapped the ControlNet slot for the img2img slot, producing hours of misdiagnosed 'regression'. RULE: nobody freehands a paint call — paint_room.py reads THIS file and pins the API shape. The crypt base_prompt is the byte-repro-verified v3.5 winner (job_fxTssiHBxHfkSnf8TtAqjKs5; base asset_nLpb, md5 05a32d314fca at seed 12345 cs0.85).

flux._note: 3 seeds = the best-of-N selection gate (promoted-recipe precedent); seed[0] byte-reproduces the canonical crypt base when the depth asset matches.

gemini.structure_lock: CRITICAL STRUCTURE-LOCK (non-negotiable, checked pixel-by-pixel against the original): every wall, pillar, archway, doorway, staircase, and prop must stay in EXACTLY its current position, size, and shape — do NOT move, add, remove, resize, or recompose ANYTHING; only the paint and lighting treatment changes. Keep the exact same isometric dimetric camera. Do NOT introduce any repeated, cloned, or tiled decorative motifs. Do NOT add any text, letters, numbers, labels, legends, map insets, UI elements, frames, or borders. Do NOT add any characters, people, figures, or creatures. The dark area outside the room walls stays dark empty background — add nothing there, no bones, objects, or debris outside the room. Do NOT add any staircases, steps, balconies, galleries, railings, mezzanines, or upper floors ANYWHERE — this is a strictly SINGLE-STOREY room and every empty corner stays an empty corner (measured defect: invented staircases on 3/3 prior rooms).

crypt.base_prompt: Painterly isometric ancient stone crypt interior, firelit, in the Pillars of Eternity 2 Deadfire hand-painted concept-art style. A spacious tomb chamber: a grand central raised stone sarcophagus monument with a stepped base, carved relief tiers, and a rounded coffin lid bearing a carved reclining knight effigy, the clear focal point with open flagstone floor on all sides; four matching round stone columns on low chamfered bases, their shafts wound with weathered Celtic knotwork relief, standing at the four corners of the chamber; an arched stone doorway with carved jambs and a curved arch lintel in the far wall, flanked by two lit iron braziers on pedestal stands with round fire bowls burning bright, like a ceremonial gate; two arched recessed funerary alcoves with relief panels set into the far wall; a second arched stone doorway with carved jambs in the right-hand wall marked by a lit torch; a rounded funerary urn with grave goods beside the tomb; a scattered pile of skulls and bones inside the left corner of the room with one cracked broken floor slab; cobwebs in the corners; worn flagstone floor, deep atmospheric shadows, warm torch chiaroscuro against cool stone, oil-painted texture, high detail, clean readable architectural composition, generous open floor space.
crypt.gemini_grounding: Repaint this image in EXACTLY the hand-painted style of a Pillars of Eternity 2: Deadfire pre-rendered isometric background: visible oil-brush strokes, muted painterly stone palette, warm-core/cool-periphery chiaroscuro — a warm-amber firelight pool centered on the tomb and braziers that falls off toward cooler blue-violet shadow at the room corners and columns; every column, sarcophagus tier, wall block, urn, and bone must remain faintly readable even in the darkest area. SCENE-CONTENT GROUNDING: the tall round shapes are carved STONE COLUMNS with weathered knotwork relief; the central raised block is a carved stone SARCOPHAGUS TOMB with a reclining knight effigy; the pedestal bowls with flames are iron BRAZIERS; recessed wall shapes are arched funerary ALCOVES and DOORWAYS (dark receding openings); worn stone FLAGSTONE floor; enclosed underground crypt with stone-block walls.
